time_unix_nano.description: Native LogRecord Unix epoch nanoseconds from logical input observed_at (omitted from Body), range 1..9223372036854775807. body.description: One compact v2 event object with observed_at and occurrence_id omitted per the log Body binding schema. No literal CR/LF, trailing newline, or SIEM wrapper.
